title: Radiation at Gale (RAD)

values.label: Surface GCR dose equivalent rate (average)
values.note: Measured on the Gale Crater traverse during sols 13–300 near solar maximum (Hassler et al. 2014).

values.label: Surface GCR absorbed dose rate (tissue-like plastic)
values.note: Detector E tissue-equivalent plastic scintillator average over sols 13–300 (Hassler et al. 2014, Table 1).

values.label: Sept 2017 surface SEP event (absorbed dose in silicon)
values.note: Largest solar energetic particle event recorded at Mars surface by RAD silicon detector B during 10–13 Sept 2017 (Zeitlin et al. 2018; Cohen & Mewaldt 2018).

values.label: Modeled 4-hour Marswalk GCR dose (unshielded)
values.note: Scenario estimate scaling the 0.64 mSv/day GCR baseline to a 4-hour excursion; suit and terrain sky-view shielding not modeled.

limits.label: NASA career effective dose limit
limits.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 (career limit for all astronauts)

limits.label: Spatial radiation map at walk scale
limits.source: RAD is a single rover-local point dosimeter (the only surface dosimeter on Mars); no walk-scale spatial map exists

note: Curiosity RAD is a rover-local dosimeter, not a spatial map across the ops box. SEP peak value (418 µGy) is absorbed dose in silicon, not directly equivalent to mSv effective dose.
claim_boundary: Context card only — never rendered as a spatial hazard heatmap. Modeled walk dose scales the Observed GCR baseline by excursion duration (Scenario).
source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343:1244797, doi:10.1126/science.1244797; Zeitlin et al. 2018, GRL 45:5845–5851, doi:10.1029/2018GL077760; Cohen & Mewaldt 2018, Space Weather 16:1616–1623, doi:10.1029/2018SW002006; PDS PPI MSL-M-RAD-2-EDR-V1.0; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1
date_range: 2012-08 → 2013-06 (sols 13–300 GCR baseline, Hassler et al. 2014); 2017-09-10 → 2017-09-13 (Sept 2017 SEP event, Zeitlin et al. 2018)
